root_cause_diagnosis.explanation: The reported 84.7% error reduction was computed as: (0.0889 - 0.0136) / 0.0889 = 84.7019% ~ 84.7%. The baseline value 0.0889 is the ordinal CORAL cumulative cutpoint MAE (using pt['predictions']), which matches the stored checkpoint metric (MAE=0.0889, Accuracy=93.71%). In contrast, 0.1234 is the categorical argmax MAE (using argmax(pt['probabilities']), Accuracy=91.98%). Prior text inadvertently paired the categorical argmax baseline MAE (0.1234) with the ordinal cutpoint reduction (84.7%). If using the argmax baseline (0.1234), the reduction to 0.0136 is 88.98%. Because MonotonicCORAL is an ordinal regression model, the ordinal cutpoint prediction (MAE=0.0889, Accuracy=93.71%) is the mathematically appropriate primary formulation, yielding exactly an 84.7% reduction to 0.0136.
